core_connection.text: Calm Support is the customer support team for Mia's Calm Premium subscription. Mia has contacted them to cancel plans and get refunds for unwanted charges.

evidence.quote: I would like to cancel my Calm Premium subscription
Thank you for turning off the auto-renewal.

facts.text: Calm Support is the customer support team for Calm, the meditation app where Mia has a Calm Premium subscription.
Mia's Calm Premium annual plan renewed on June 1, 2025 for $69.99, and she asked for a refund.
Mia had not opened the app since August 2024 and said she got no reminder before the renewal.

evidence.quote: I have not opened the app since August 2024
I did not receive a reminder

facts.text: Mia contacted them two days after the June 2025 charge and wanted the refund sent to her original payment method, not as account credits.

evidence.quote: I'm contacting you two days after the charge.

facts.text: Support turned off auto-renewal. Mia then asked them to review the charge again and escalate it if the first support level could not approve the refund.

evidence.quote: Thank you for turning off the auto-renewal.

facts.text: On May 9, 2026 Mia restarted Calm Premium and picked the $14.99 monthly plan, but was charged $69.99 for the annual plan.

evidence.quote: I selected the monthly plan at $14.99
I was charged $69.99 for the annual plan instead

facts.text: Mia first asked them to switch her to the monthly plan and refund the $55.00 difference.
Mia then asked them to cancel the annual plan and refund the full $69.99. She said she would sign up for the monthly plan again herself after the refund.

evidence.quote: I will sign up for the monthly plan again myself

facts.text: Mia's emails to them are polite but firm. She states the facts and asks them to confirm the cancellation and the exact refund amount.

evidence.quote: Please confirm the plan change and the amount being refunded.
